evidence.note: Stock kl:intern given its exact denotation: on a digit-led name of length > 1 it returns the host string->number answer when that is a number (sampled: (intern 12-string) is the integer 12 on v0.52), so it diverges from rule_intern there (OB-SCHEME-INTERN-NUMERIC stays refuted) and agrees elsewhere. The proposed patch (ports/patches/shen-scheme-primitives.diff) is proved to refine rule_intern for every string. The compile-time fold of a literal (intern S) calls the compiling image's kl:intern; it matches only in a binary rebuilt with the patch.

evidence.note: Captured |intern| refines rule_intern on every name without the characters hash, quote, backquote and bar, given the uncaptured shen-cl.process-intern (a LOOP body) as the named contract CLStrings.cl_intern_ops.process_plain. Names with those characters are mangled; two distinct names can then intern to the same symbol (sampled on SBCL 2.6.8, docs/UPSTREAM-ISSUES-INTERN.md).
Captured |pos| refines rule_pos on every represented argument pair: the one-character string in range; a raise for an out-of-range or non-integer index or a non-string.
Captured |tlstr| refines rule_tlstr on every represented argument; the empty string and non-strings raise.
Captured |string?| proved to be the Shen-test refinement of STRINGP at the emitted arity.

Captured |n->string| refines rule_n_to_string on ASCII codes, out-of-range integers and non-integers; every scalar value is accepted by both. Discovered divergence n_to_string_surrogate: a surrogate code returns a string where the rule is a domain error (OB-CL-N-TO-STRING-SURROGATE). Code points 256 and above lie outside the ASCII string model.

Captured |string->n| refines rule_string_to_n on unit and empty strings and non-strings. Discovered divergence string_to_n_long: a string of length 2 or more raises where the rule answers the first code point (OB-CL-STRING-TO-N-UNIT).
Mapped directly to CL CAR (CAR of NIL is NIL: domain divergence, owner E2E-16/21).
Captured |cons?| proved to be the Shen-test refinement of CONSP at the emitted arity.

Captured absequal proved on first-order data; the EQ rewrite of a quoted comparand is exact iff the comparand is a symbol or NIL (CLLowering.qsafe). Every specialization the optimizer emits (NULL, EQ, EQUAL with a string literal, numeric-equal with a numeric literal) is proved for every value against the captured bodies (CLContracts). Open: the vector branch (cf-vectors LOOP) between two vectors, floats inside =.

Captured |<-address| is exactly SVREF; it refines rule_address_get (element in range, raise otherwise) for every heap vector represented element-wise by the host simple vector. That heap correspondence is an E2E-21 premise.
Captured shen-cl.add proved exact on all integers, and shen-cl.increment (CLContracts.CLContracts.increment_int). Open: floats.
Captured shen-cl.subtract proved exact on all integers, and shen-cl.decrement (CLContracts.CLContracts.decrement_int). Open: floats.
Captured shen-cl.multiply proved exact on all integers; it answers 0 for (* 0 non-number) where KLambda raises (multiply_zero_absorbs_symbol).
Captured shen-cl.divide proved: exact quotient, DIVISION-BY-ZERO, or the host double of x/y (never a ratio); int_div_inexact must be pinned to that conversion.
